title: Freshwater Friends ABC
hook: Freshwater letters move side by side.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: brief retrieval pause, then warm confirmation
visualStyle: cute freshwater animal 3D storybook, pond blues and leafy greens, expressive but anatomically clear creatures, uncluttered

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: friendly freshwater nature host following animals, plants and water objects
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: motion-word hook linking swim, hop and glide
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written freshwater snapshots where rhyme clusters are organized around motion families such as sway, glide, hop, paddle, flow, and flash
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: cue, gap, confirmation and safe mimed motion; Hydrilla remains point-only
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 marimba/ukulele; chorus adds snaps; Round 2 soft kick drops out on targets and uses finger-tap answers
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Compose A to Z as a freshwater movement score: each plant, animal, or object contributes a visible motion, and the child learns by feeling a sequence of sway, paddle, hop, flash, float, and glide.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Motion verbs are the melody's vocabulary. Lines should show how different bodies move through the same water world, using clusters of related action-sounds rather than generic location description.
semanticArc: motion grows more varied across bank and channel
one last tail flick and leaf sway settle the song
